subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The prescribed root cause fix was not implemented. The file contains only a bare createContext<IContentstackContext>({}) with no ContentstackProvider component, no useState, no useEffect, and no Stack.livePreview subscription. The context remains a static value that never updates after initial render, so no downstream consumer (236+ components via useContent) can receive real-time CMS edits. None of the six verification criteria can be satisfied because there is no reactivity mechanism whatsoever.
issues.suggestedFix: Create a ContentstackProvider component in this file that: (1) accepts defaultContent as a prop and initializes it via useState; (2) in a useEffect, initializes the Contentstack live preview listener using Stack.livePreview with the app's existing SDK config (the live_preview config already used by getSingletonEntry/getSingleEntry in getStaticProps helpers); (3) calls the state setter on each 'entryUpdate' callback so the entire content tree re-renders with fresh CMS data without a page reload. Wrap the application (or the content tree) with this provider so useContent consumers receive reactive updates.

issues.description: The file path specified in the task (src/context/ContentstackContext.tsx with uppercase 'C') does not exist. The actual file is src/context/contentstackContext.tsx (lowercase 'c'). This mismatch suggests the prescribed fix may have been applied to the wrong file or not applied at all.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure the live preview implementation is in the correct file: src/context/contentstackContext.tsx. Verify the import paths in useContent.ts and all consumers still resolve correctly.

issues.description: useContent calls useContext(ContentstackContext) but since no Provider with reactive state was added, the context value remains the static default {}. Even if a Provider were added, useContent itself does not need changes — but the lack of a Provider means getContentByKey will always return default values, and no live preview updates will propagate. The hook is correct in pattern but depends on the missing Provider.
issues.suggestedFix: No change needed to useContent.ts itself once the ContentstackProvider with useState + useEffect live preview listener is implemented in contentstackContext.tsx. The useContext call will automatically re-render when the Provider's state changes.

issues.description: The IContentstackContext interface uses untyped 'any' for the footer field: footer?: [any]. This violates TypeScript strict compliance — no untyped 'any' without an explanatory comment.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace [any] with a proper interface type (e.g., [IContentstackFooter]) or add an explanatory comment if the type is genuinely unknown.
